title: A new way to discover the power of Assets
description:
We’ve updated the Assets landing page for Free plans in Jira Service Management to help you better understand how to manage your resources. This change introduces new ways to explore how Assets works with Data Manager and Dashboards, giving you a clearer picture of how to track and manage your organization's infrastructure within your Atlassian app. To explore the new Assets experience: Open your Jira Service Management project.
	Select Assets from the navigation menu on the left.
